high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a social media post from Channel NewsAsia (CNA), dated 20 hours prior to the screenshot being taken at 02:43. The post features a commentary titled "Vaccine fatigue leaves Singapore vulnerable to falling ill." The text is presented in white against a black background, with a "Tap to Read" button below the title. The image within the post shows a close-up of a vaccination process. A healthcare worker, wearing a face mask and a dark uniform with an orange circular patch, is administering a vaccine to a person's upper arm. The healthcare worker is holding a syringe
